content:
Yes, this is the infamous quote attributed to **Mark Zuckerberg** from early 2004, shortly after he launched Facebook (then "TheFacebook") at Harvard.

It reportedly comes from a private instant message conversation he had with a friend, where he was discussing the data Harvard students were voluntarily submitting to his new site.

The exchange was published by **Business Insider** in 2010 and has become one of the most frequently cited examples in discussions about Facebook/Meta and data privacy concerns.

Zuckerberg was 19 at the time. He later acknowledged the messages and characterized them as reflecting immaturity, saying he had grown since then.
